segments.en:
All riiight!
Let's head ouuut!!

rows.notes: [proofread 0] style sheet 'All right' (not 'Alright'), stretched form as 'All riiight' elsewhere in the corpus

segments.en:
Our future is riding
on this fight!!
I'll do my best too!
Well then, let's get this started!!

If there's anything even I can do,
I'll just give it my all!

Okaaay,
I'm gonna do my best!

Listen up!
In battle, you must always look
one or two moves ahead!

If you desire victory, know your
machine's capabilities inside and out.
Amuro Ray, moving out!

Prepare for launch!
Don't slack on scanning
in every direction!
Very well, I'm heading out too!
Go, my Funnels!
Kamille Bidan, launching!

Warriors must keep fighting
for as long as they live.

rows.notes: Generic 'warrior' made plural ('they') to avoid a gendered pronoun.

segments.en: I sense pressure... Who is it?
Heh. Behold my power!

I can handle any machine there is--
just watch me!

For those who wallow in idle slumber,
this is what a nightmare truly is.
Life is cheap... Especially mine...

This hand of mine is burning red!
Its loud roar tells me to grasp victory!!

Show me, then,
how far your shallow wits
can take you!
Leave it to meee!

All right!
Time to get fired up!

You will never win a battle
by being soft on yourself.

Behold my swordsmanship,
and mark it well!

I believe in my own strength!
I won't be ruled by anyone else!
I've been waiting for this~!

rows.notes: [accuracy 0] subject restored: Kaine is the one who has been waiting ([jp])

segments.en:
Do not underestimate
the Blue Falcon of Giganos!
Roger! I'll give it my all too.

The only place I can find rest
is in the middle of battle!
Rei, activate V-MAX!!

Let any who stand in the way of my ideals
prepare themselves for death!

Dee-hahahahahaha!
I can't get enough of this!!
All right, let's do this!
Bring it on!!
Give it your all, brave one!

rows.notes: [jp]: GGG's 'Brave' address; singular 'brave one' (listener = player); row 140 [jp] -> 'my brave ones'.

segments.en:
As long as Fighbird is here, I won't
let anyone disturb the peace of the universe!

Let's go!
Might Gaine!

No matter how unfair things get,
I believe in justice!

There's no such thing as justice in
this world! You beat them or they
beat you--that's all there is!

Absolutely Invincible!
Raaaijin-Ohhh!!

All right, here we go!
Gambaruger, Miracle Combination!!

Let's do it!
Like I'd give up now!

All right!
We've gotta do this after all, huh!

Believe... in the strength
of your feelings.
Well, then. Shall we begin?
Big O! Showtime!
I can hear it... the sound of battle...
Come ooon, Daiojaaa!!
All right, here I goooo!!
Come play with Himikooo!!

rows.notes: Himiko refers to herself in the third person; kept.

segments.en:
Welp...
guess I'll get going.

Everyone!
The battle's about to begin!
Are you ready?!

That's more like it!
Anything less would be no fun!
All right, I'll show 'em!!

I'll show you!
Thing is, I just can't afford to lose!

Don't let your guard down!
Show no mercy!
Crush them completely!!

Now then, heaven or hell...
choose whichever you like!

Come now, show me
your will to fight.
Let me see what you are capable of!

rows.notes: [jp] 'you officers' -- rendered as plain 'you' (gender/rank-neutral).

segments.en:
If it is to protect peace,
then battle cannot be helped!
The die has been cast.

Those who will not fight
have no right to live!
All right, let's do this!!

Focus your speed on one point and break
through, and even the thickest mass shatters!
Hahahahahahaaaaa!!

Here it comes!
The ideas are gushing forth like a flood
and simply will not stop!
Let's settle this!!
All right, let's get down to it!

rows.notes: [editorial 0] 'shall we...?!' too stiff for Kanji's casual voice; rhetorical [jp]

segments.en: All right! Let's do this!!
This here's Gallery Mode.

The more you play the game, the more
pictures you get to see, and fast!

So, put your back into it
and collect 'em all!!

rows.notes: [editorial 0] mode name without article, as 'Mission Mode'

segments.en: Go for it, everyone!
Hah! You're nothing special at all!
This is a far cry from elegance.

Immature! Immature!
Utterly immature!!
Is that all you've got?!
I have high hopes for you.
How miserable...

Hmph, you weakling.
How boring.
Let's do it!

rows.notes: [jp]: subject unstated (Himiko's -noda voice); rendered 'Let's do it!' -- could also be 'Do it!' (urging the listener).

segments.en:
Not yet!
This ain't anywhere near enough for me!
I need more!
I've gotta do my best!
How pa-thetic!

rows.notes: [jp]: target unstated (likely the loser/listener); emphatic 'pa-thetic'.

segments.en: That was nothing.

rows.notes: [jp]: quip with no context; 'That was nothing' (about the opponent/fight).

segments.en: I have to do something!

Don't worry!
You can do it!

Too stiff, too stiff!
Loosen up a little!
Not bad at all!

No real resistance...
Is this all there is?
I can still keep going.
Now, show me true justice!

Come, then. Attack me
with everything you have.
Now this is getting interesting!
Let's give it our best!
You're still far too green.

Not yet! Not yet, not yet!
It is not over yeeet!
Fight, fight!

Go all out and...
ATTAAACK!
You're still way too soft!
This much is no big deal.

What you lack is...! Passion, ideology,
ideals, thought, dignity, grace, diligence,
and above all, you lack SPEED!
I'm counting on ya!

Don't push yourself.
The fight's only just getting started.
Yo! How's it going?
All right! Let's give it our best!
Hey! Glad you made it!

Not good enough yet!
Try mixing things up a bit.
Not bad at all.
You can still keep going, right?!

Not yet...
I'm not finished yet!

Shall we end it here?
Or shall we continue?
This might take some doing.
Hey, you're pretty good!
Hoh... you're not half bad.

Time to tighten the elastic on my
underpants and get serious!
Hahaha! You're in fine form!

rows.notes: [jp]: read as praise/taunt toward the listener; could also be Horla on his own form.

segments.en: Hmm... quite impressive.

You're fighting for real, and you're
living for real. Good for you.

rows.notes: Doubled [jp] rendered as 'fought your hardest / came out alive'. | [accuracy 0] parallel [jp]...[jp] restored and tense kept present ([jp] = living properly, not 'came out alive')

segments.en:
It's over already?
Himiko wants to play mooore~!
Nnngh... you're good, you are.

rows.notes: [jp] (archaic 'thou') conveyed by the 'you are' tag; speaker gender blank in sheet, no pronoun used.

segments.en: Not bad. Not bad at all.

Something is still missing!
The hunger, the thirst inside me!
They have not been satisfied!
We're almost there!
Man, this one's pretty good!

rows.notes: [jp] (opponent, gender unknown) -> 'this one'.

segments.en: Just a little more. Let's do our best.
Oh ho... not bad at all.

Don't wind yourself
too tight, okay?

All riiight!
That's quite a collection already!

rows.notes: [jp]: collector unstated (player's gallery); kept impersonal. | [proofread 0] style sheet 'All right' (not 'Alright'), stretched form as 'All riiight' elsewhere in the corpus

segments.en:
Almost there.
Don't give up on me now!
Just one more push!
The rest is all about guts!
Good work. Get some rest.

I am moved by the efforts
of each and every one of you.

Does this mean... I won't have to
suffer anymore?
You did more than well enough.

Impossible!
I never thought you'd go this far!

rows.notes: [jp]: subject unstated; Versus quip aimed at the opponent -> 'you'.

segments.en: Well done. Rest easy now.
No more need be said...!
Hehe~, way to go!

rows.notes: [jp]: rendered 'way to go' (at the listener); could be 'we did it'.

segments.en: Eheheheheh, this is great!

This is so fun, my brain's
about to boil over!

Mm! Well done,
my brave ones!

rows.notes: [accuracy 0] dropped interjection [jp] restored

segments.en:
In any case, you did well.
Congratulations!

Nyahahahaha,
we did iiit~~~!

rows.notes: [jp]: subject unstated; 'we did it' (could be Himiko alone).

segments.en:
Even I must admit
this one has me beaten~!

Satisfied! For the first time ever,
I am satisfied! This is the summit!
Terrifying! This is a terrifying thing!

You have done well.
Your service is commended.
It's over... Good work, everyone.
You sure pulled it off!

rows.notes: [jp]: grouped with the win lines -> admiring; could be sarcastic 'Look what you did'.

segments.en:
That fighting spirit... magnificent!
I look forward to the day we
cross blades once more!

Neverending!
The story continues on to Act Two!
COMPLEEEEEETE!!
You actually did it!

I'm just gonna come right out
and say it: congratulations!

I'm sooo glad you stuck
with me all the way!!

I'm gonna follow your example
and give it my all too!

See ya!
Let's meet again somewhere!!
Yahooo!
Nice work out there!
Well, see ya!
Come back again, y'hear!
Come back and hang out again!
